René Rykel Koiter is one of Blizzard's most influential artists. He used to be known as Twincruiser along with his late brother Michel Koiter. Koiter is presently working as a web designer for Blizzard Entertainment and Sons of the Storm. In World of Warcraft, he plays as an orc shaman. He's listed in the World of Warcraft: Classic credits under Story & Franchise Development - Blizzard Video, Creative.
Rena Durham is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.

A response message on a private Chat Channels (Whisper or Tell) only seen by your character and another player character. You can only reply if you were sent a Whisper or Tell. You reply by typing /r or pressing "r"
Your efforts against the Burning Blade in the Valley of Trials have come to an end. You are to leave the valley and head to Sen'jin Village to find out if the Burning Blade has reached them.

__NOTOC__ This quest directly sends you to Blood Watch, where the majority of quests in Bloodmyst Isle start.

Report Back to Fizzlebub is a neutral quest from the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. In this quest, players return to Booty Bay to let Crank Fizzlebub know how Kravel Koalbeard's scheme went. Go to the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles, and talk to Kravel Koalbeard. Players must have completed either Get the Gnomes Drunk or Get the Goblins Drunk to receive this quest.
This quest is part of the The Farstrider Enclave quest chain. This quest chain starts with The Farstrider Enclave.
Report to Tarren Mill is a quest for blood elves to get to Hillsbrad Foothills
You were the one to find the box of parts, it is only right that you carry word to someone who will know how to act on the information... This quest is part of quest chain.
Report to the Allerian Post is the 2nd quest in the What Are These Things? quest chain.
A reptilian warrior with a shell reminiscent of a turtle's was an Ancient Guardian during the War of the Ancients.

The Repository in Karazhan lies beyond Guardian's Library. It is a dead-end room located through a secret entrance behind a mysterious bookcase. The Repositary is the location of Terestian Illhoof, as well as a few of his grell minions. A spell circle sits in the center of the room.
The Report from the Frontlines: Western Northrend can be found behind Highlord Darion Mograine on the first floor of Acherus: The Ebon Hold.
The Report from the Frontlines: Eastern Kingdoms can be found on the first floor of Acherus: The Ebon Hold near Highlord Darion Mograine.
The Report from the Frontlines: Dragonblight can be found on the first floor of Acherus: The Ebon Hold near Highlord Darion Mograine. It can also be found in Death's Breach in the Scarlet Enclave.
Represent is a collections achievement earned for collecting a unique tabard.
Repulsion Totem was a talent planned to be introduced with Mists of Pandaria.
Reprogrammed Defendo-tank 66Ds are mechano-tanks found in the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra. Alliance players are able to reprogram the Defendo-tank 66Ds into these.

Replica Shado-Pan Helmet is a Shado-Pan reputation reward, sold for approximately (varying by armor type) from at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes. It comes in cloth, leather, mail and plate versions, and requires reputation to purchase.

Replica General's Leather Treads is a transmogrifiable replica of General's Leather Treads. This item can be purchased from Tini Smalls in Netherstorm, but only if the player has earned Legionnaire (or its legacy version, Legionnaire (Legacy)) or higher.
__NOTOC__ The Replica Blood Guard's Cleaver is looted from Horde Strongbox.
The Replica Staff of Gul'dan is looted from Horde Strongbox which is a reward from the Fight for the Horde achievement.

The Replica Lion's Fang is looted from Alliance Strongbox. It is a replica of the sword wielded by Llane Wrynn I. While previously merely a movie reference, Llane's appearances in Return to Karazhan with the actual Lion's Fang have carried over the sword into canon.
The Report from Zuldazar was provided as an objective for Open Your Eyes.
Reprogrammed Scavenge-bots 005-B6 are crowd pummelers located in the Borean Tundra.
Repugnant Shadowdwellers are pale orcs located in the Spires of Arak.

Reprogrammed Librarians are mechagnomes riding mechanostriders on the Terrace of the Makers in the Storm Peaks during Operation: Troggageddon.

Reprogrammed Scavenge-bot 004-A8 are crowd pummelers pets located in the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra that are a result of using The Ultrasonic Screwdriver on Scavenge-bot 004-A8 during Master and Servant, although they try to help they deal 1 damage and disappear 50 seconds later.
The Reprogrammed Warbot is a clockwork robot located in the Vision of Stormwind.
Replicating Shadows is an Azerite trait available to Subtlety rogues.

Report to the Queen concludes the week three chapter of the Night Fae Campaign. The next chapter unlocks at Renown (Shadowlands) 11, first achievable the week of December 15, starting the quest The Speaker of Elune.
The Repulsion Cypher would have been crafted through Soul Cyphering.

The Replicating Seed of Abundance can be looted from the Challenger's Cache at the end of a successful level 7 or higher Mythic+ dungeon after the start of Battle for Azeroth Season 3. Only classes with a tank specialization can loot it. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 2 of the Life-Binder's Invocation Essence and leave behind a Withering Seed.
